mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lymph drainage network was worthwhile because the picture showed a continuous route from around cells back to a vein and explained why fluid return matters.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to connect the tiny and larger lymph vessels was confusing: the pictures suggested a direct connection, but the larger route had to be prepared first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the small-vessel drainage could not connect directly to the larger vessels before their vein connection was built.

arbitrary.text: That prerequisite felt arbitrary at first because its purpose was not clear from the pictures, even though the completed route made sense afterward.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: putting the separate systems together made their different jobs clearer, and I would be curious to see another connection explained that way.
